EVIDENCE
STATUS

All required reservations and confirmations are complete. There is room for two additional participants and two spare kits.

EVIDENCE
O11 consolidates the adopted plan; O12 confirms no subsequent changes. Room capacity is 24 participants, inventory is 24 usable kits, and two leaders support 24 participants at one leader per twelve. The booking fits within inclusive 09:00–17:00 room availability, and both leaders cover the full session. Headphones throughout are explicitly exempt from the pre-11:00 amplified-sound prohibition. Earlier 09:30 and speaker ideas were discarded proposals.

NEXT
For an attendance-only change, retain the booking, duration, headphones, inventory, and leader confirmations. Totals up to 24 fit all capacities; 25 or more exceed room, kit, and staffing capacities. No further approval gate or invitation decision is required for this feasibility check. If assumptions explicitly change, recover O01–O04 for activity and capacity rules, O06 for confirmations, and O07 for sound restrictions.
